title: [finding] The `search-fields.ts` docblock still says `$search` expands to an `$or` of `$contains` — a fourth site in the #7641 family, in `packages/spec` rather than `objectql`
body:
Filed unassigned by the `os-dev` seat that implemented #13988. **Recording only — no severity asserted, routing is triage's.** Found by the mandatory `origin/main` sweep for tests pinning the old wording while implementing #13988; it is a site that card did not claim and explicitly could not have, because #13988's thesis is the **published** docs.

Measured on `origin/main` at `0fb944b4`.

## The site

`packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts:9`, in the module docblock:

> - the ENGINE (`@objectstack/objectql` `expandSearchToFilter`), which expands
>   a `$search` term into a `$or` of `$contains` clauses over exactly this set;

`expandSearchToFilter` has compiled `$search` to `$icontains` since #7641. `packages/objectql/src/search-filter.ts:23` carries the ruling verbatim — *"The case-insensitive operator is `$icontains`, NOT `$contains`. `$contains` is contractually case-SENSITIVE (#4706 Q2 = A)"* — and `fieldClausesForTerm` emits `$icontains` on both of its return paths.

## Why this is a fourth card and not part of the three that exist

This family has been filed one card per site, by where the sentence lives:

- #13744 — `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (landed)
- #13984 — `packages/objectql/src/search-companion.ts`
- #13988 — the six **published** doc sites (`packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts`'s `.describe()` plus the four rows it generates, and three hand-written pages)

`search-fields.ts` is none of those. Two measurements place it outside #13988:

1. **It is not published.** `grep 'clauses over exactly this set' content/` returns **zero** hits, with a firing positive control on the same corpus (`grep -rln 'server-resolved searchable fields' content/docs` hits `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx`), so the zero is a reading. It is a TSDoc on a plain module, not a `.describe()` on a schema, so nothing routes it into `content/docs/references/`.
2. **It is a different package from the two code cards.** They are `packages/objectql`; this is `packages/spec`.

## Dedupe

Full REST enumeration of open items at the time of filing — 530 of 530 (`open_issues_count` matched exactly; 5 pages of 100 plus a short page of 30), title and body grep. **Zero** hits for `search-fields`, with a firing positive control on the same corpus (a grep for `icontains`/`13988` over the same 530 returned #14079, #13988 and #6017). No duplicate.

## What this does NOT claim

- ⛔ No behaviour is wrong. This is a docblock sentence, not a code path.
- ⛔ I did not sweep for further code-side copies beyond the grep that surfaced this one; that grep was scoped to `packages/**` and `scripts/**` for the exact phrase `$or` of `$contains`. Its other two hits are **correct** and unrelated to `$search`: `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts:2646` and the test at `sql-driver-json-column-operator-refusal.test.ts:254` both describe `$or` of `$contains` as the any-of spelling for JSON columns, which is a different mechanism.
- ⛔ I did not fix it in #13988's PR. It is outside that card's declared file surface, and folding it in would have widened a diff whose `check:generated` blast radius was a measured hypothesis.
- I assert no severity and no priority.

**Refs**: #13988 (the published-docs half, PR open) · #13744 · #13984 · #7641 / #4706 (the adjudication chain).
